title: H6: the gate checks that every acceptance-named test id exists in the worktree before running the suite; missing ids are a gate_red with the ids in resume_hint.failures so the automatic fix round handles them
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353. Evidence: five Phase G tasks (T-0271, T-0326, T-0273, T-0277, T-0348) came back with tests-green exit 0 while none of the acceptance-named tests existed; each cost a review round or a Planner codex_reply. The gate cannot fail on absent tests.
1. New helper orchestrator/acceptance.py: named_tests(acceptance) parses every "tests/<file>.py::<name>" reference (also the shorthand "::name" continuing the previous file in the same criterion, as Phase G specs wrote them) into (path, name) pairs; missing_tests(worktree, acceptance) returns the pairs whose file lacks a line matching "def <name>(" (unittest and pytest style; class methods count). Tolerate acceptance entries that are not test references.
2. daemon.gate: before running tests-green.sh, compute missing = missing_tests(worktree, task acceptance). When non-empty, mark the gate red exactly like a failing suite: hold_reason gate_red, resume_hint.failures = ["FAILED <path>::<name> (missing: test not defined)" for each], resume_hint.missing_tests = the pairs, log one stderr line, and skip the suite run. daemon.auto_fix_round's pytest-line extraction must accept these lines so the automatic fix round fires with the missing ids in its packet (the fix-round.md packet lists them under failures). A task whose acceptance names no tests behaves exactly as today.
3. merge gate unchanged (the worktree gate is the place).
Tests in tests/test_daemon.py: test_gate_red_when_acceptance_test_missing (holds with the ids, suite not run), test_gate_runs_suite_when_named_tests_exist, test_auto_fix_round_fires_on_missing_test_ids; tests/test_acceptance.py: test_named_tests_parses_full_and_shorthand_ids, test_missing_tests_detects_absent_definitions. Keep every existing test green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: a task whose acceptance names tests that are not defined in the worktree is held gate_red with those ids in resume_hint.failures without running the suite
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
